Data & methodology

Question and reader

This report is for a club performance analyst comparing attacking chance creation. It asks which team in Europe’s top five leagues generated the highest xG per game and average total xG per season from 2021–22 through 2025–26.

Source and unit of observation

Source: Understat. One CSV row represents one team in one completed domestic league season. Match-level xG is added into season totals. Expected goals measures the quality of scoring chances; it is not the actual number of goals scored.

Download the exact CSV used by both pages

Which rows count?

Cup matches, European competitions, playoffs and the unfinished 2026–27 season are outside the dataset. No missing xG is replaced with zero. Teams are matched across seasons using Understat’s team ID.

How the four summary numbers are computed

  1. Highest team xG per game: the maximum, across included teams, of total xG divided by total games.
  2. Highest team average xG per season: the maximum, across included teams, of total xG divided by that team’s number of included seasons.
  3. Teams compared: distinct team IDs after the filters and coverage rule.
  4. Team-season records included: the count of CSV rows after the filters and coverage rule.

Consistent comparisons

The default view requires a team to appear in every selected season. On the dashboard, disabling this rule includes teams with fewer seasons and uses each team’s observed seasons as the denominator. A one-season selection compares that season’s participants.

Per-game rates use combined xG divided by combined matches, rather than an unweighted mean of season rates. Calculations use the CSV’s stored precision and round only for display. Ties are ordered alphabetically without implying a meaningful difference.

What these rankings do not adjust for

The rankings compare domestic chance creation, not opponent-adjusted team strength. League quality, schedule length, penalties and differences in opposition are not controlled for. xG models differ between providers, so Understat is used throughout.

Team xG/game = SUM(Total_xG) / SUM(Matches_Played)

Team xG/season = SUM(Total_xG) / COUNTD(Season)

Website & Tableau agreement

Default filters: all five leagues, all five seasons, all teams; require a record in every selected season. Compare the same rows in Tableau.

Native Tableau results verified October 25, 2026: 2.82 xG per game, 95.85 average xG per season, 64 teams and 320 team-season records.
